text.text_excerpt: When staying here for business, the staff and decor of The Hotel Modern had me from the minute I stepped in. Not too big (The Hyatt was a nightmare to maneuver at my conference) and not too small! I have to start with the beds, most comfortable and clean I have had at any hotel. The light that shone in at night was easily blocked out by a separate shade under the blinds. The front desk and security staff were wonderful to my coworker and I. We felt like we were leaving friends when we left! Our bags were never locked and money and jewelry were all accounted for. When I travel back to NOLA (and next time it will be purely for fun), we will definitely be staying at The Hotel Modern. With it...

Stayed here recently for almost a week while on vacation. We got a really great price and booked it about a month or so in advance. The hotel is old but has a cool vibe and I like to area of the city it is in. It's not really walking distance to the French quarter but there are street car stops within steps of the hotel which I really enjoyed riding. It's nice not being so close to the loud and busy areas. The staff is polite and nice but keep mostly to themselves, there is no pool and parking is insane. There is a parking garage a couple of blocks away for 1/3 the price. The rooms are incredibly small. As far as comfort goes the bed and pillows could best be called acceptable. The bathtu...

We stayed at the Hotel Modern recently and had a great experience overall. When we mentioned that we were coming to New Orleans for our anniversary they upgraded our room at no charge. The room we got was a huge corner suite that was great for our long stay. The room was clean and good-sized, bigger than I would have guessed from the photos. Carl deserves a raise! Carl is the concierge and he is awesome. We had a great chat with him our first night and felt like we got along really well beyond just the typical "Here are my recommendations for where to go in the city."
